description: Defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) class 'EmployeeDistributionByLocation' used for representing employee distribution data by location within the OrangeHRM dashboard plugin.

classes.name: EmployeeDistributionByLocation
classes.description: A DTO class encapsulating employee distribution data, including location counts, total locations, unassigned employees, other employees, and a limit.

methods.name: getLocationCountPairs
methods.description: Returns the array of location-employee count pairs.

methods.name: getOtherEmployeeCount
methods.description: Returns the count of employees categorized as 'other'.

methods.name: getUnassignedEmployeeCount
methods.description: Returns the count of unassigned employees.

methods.name: getLimit
methods.description: Returns the limit value used in the DTO.

methods.name: getTotalLocationCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of locations.
